parsedVerdict.reasoning: The module src/business/services does not maintain a consistent persistence boundary and abstraction across its files. In src/business/services/LendingService.ts, LendingService accesses persistence exclusively through gateway abstractions (BookGateway, MemberGateway, LoanGateway) and domain entities (Book, Loan, Member). In contrast, in src/business/services/LoanHistoryService.ts, LoanHistoryService bypasses the gateway abstraction (such as LoanGateway) and injects the ORM client wrapper PrismaService directly in its constructor, issuing direct Prisma queries via db.loanEvent.create in note() and this.db.loanEvent.findMany in eventsOf().
